text:
Jamal: Heads-up — seeing ~30% throughput drop on us-east-dedicated since 09:10 UTC. Lots of short worker restarts. Suspect GPU OOM + memory fragmentation.

Alex: I see the same in the dashboard, latency p95 jumped and throughput dropped across the small-batch traffic. Noisy-tenant spike around 09:05.

Priya: Alerting group. Collecting logs from the restarted workers now.

perf-bot: Automated summary attached -> gpu_mem_free_contig: median=128MiB (was 480MiB), kernel_fallbacks=213, worker_restarts=18 in last 12m.

Lina: Quick profiling dump from worker-45: 
```
09:11:22 ERROR runtime: cuMemAlloc 0xC0000000 failed (out of memory)
09:11:22 runtime: kernel selection fallback for attn: tried fp16-vec, fallback->fp32-slow
09:11:23 kvcache: eviction spike: 1.4k/sec, avg_kv_entries_evicted=3
09:11:23 worker: process exit code 137 -> OOM -> restart
```

Marco: Kernel selection fallback is interesting — when fallback to fp32 happens memory use jumps and allocator fragments. We saw similar pattern in last month's coalescer change.

Alex: Ran quick allocator snapshot: `runtimesctl dump-mem --worker worker-45 --format=summary` ->
```
GPU 0: total=24GiB, free=3.1GiB, free_contiguous=120MiB, slabs=[64MiB: 5, 128MiB: 2, 512MiB:0]
allocations_by_kernel: attn_fp16=1.2M, attn_fp32_fallback=320k
```

Priya: So sequence: noisy tenant causes slightly larger batches -> kernel fallback (fp32) -> allocator can’t satisfy large contiguous allocs -> fragmentation -> cuMemAlloc OOM -> worker restart.

Jamal: Agreed. Batching heuristic probably allowed a large batch to coalesce across requests. We should limit max_batch_tokens when contiguous free < 256MiB.

Lina: Also kv-cache eviction thrash contributes — eviction churn causes many small frees, preventing coalescing. Suggest enabling deferred coalescing on allocator and throttling kv eviction bursts.

Marco: Quick mitigation I'm going to push: 1) rollout config change to dedicated pool: set max_batch_tokens=4096 -> 2048 for the next 30m, 2) set allocator flag --defer-coalesce=true on a canary, 3) pin model variant to quantized-8bit on hot hosts to avoid fp32 fallback.

deploy-bot: Canary deploy triggered by Marco: change set max_batch_tokens=2048 to pool us-east-dedicated-canary on 3 hosts.

Alex: After canary (5m) we see free_contiguous up to ~220MiB and zero OOM restarts on canary hosts. Throughput still slightly down but stable.

Priya: Good. I'll open an incident runbook note and set follow-ups. Action items:
- Marco: complete allocator coalesce rollout and monitor (ETA 30m)
- Lina: tune kv eviction throttle + add histogram of contiguous free to perf dashboard (ETA 2d)
- Alex: run a replay test for batching heuristic under noisy-tenant traffic (ETA EOD)
- Jamal: prepare postmortem draft after stabilization.

Jamal: One more note — long-term, we should modify kernel-selection to prefer memory-frag resilient kernels (chunked-attn, quantized paths) when GPU free_contig < X. Add to backlog.

Lina: I'll add an eval comparing kernel memory footprints under short/long sequence mixes and push findings to the runtime backlog.

Alex: Update: 09:45 UTC after allocator flag canary -> worker restarts fell to 0, throughput recovered ~95% of baseline on canary hosts. Rolling to rest of pool now with throttled cadence.

Priya: Marking incident as "mitigated" for now. Will keep monitor for 2h.

Jamal: Thanks all. Postmortem + action items in #incidents once the data is consolidated. :thumbsup:
